Report.md: Assumptions: this remains the fixture's simplified synthetic loft proxy, with assumed centimetres and a 170cm height prior. Coordinates preserve fixture X horizontal, Y up, Z depth. The existing procedural proportions and renderer are retained; height scales all axes, so circumference labels remain model controls rather than independently verified anatomical measurements at changed height. No image fitting, new anatomy, photorealism or real-person measurement accuracy is claimed. Shoulder control was outside the requested four-slider repair. Camera angles are functional; front/back geometric symmetry means differences also reflect triangle shading. Persistence assumes the same browser origin. File delivery is standalone, but Chromium execution was verified through loopback HTTP because managed file URLs are blocked.
